justification: OC-20: a rule whose citation is not machine-proven shows 'Citation not yet checked'. isCitationChecked (lib/citation-display.ts) mirrors DQ-145 (citation_status proven/imprecise OR page_check on_page/moved), is carried as citation_checked by withServedCitation on every served rule, and the rule card renders the mark unless citation_checked === true (missing = unchecked, fail closed). A jest parity test reads the DQ-145 SQL text and fails if the value sets drift.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: isCitationChecked always returns true, the card ignores citation_checked, or the DQ-145 value sets change without the helper
falsifiable_check.observed_red: With isCitationChecked forced true and the card's unchecked condition forced false, 10 of 18 tests failed (2026-10-17).
falsifiable_check.external_authority: scripts/dq_probe_live.py DQ-145 SQL text, read by the parity test

real_layer_exempt.frontend-nextjs/lib/citation-display.ts: pure function; the route test runs the real for-property handler with a mocked pool

pre_impl.existing_data: for-property already selected citation_status and page_check
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: browse, clause and cross-reference routes lack page_check so compute false (conservative) but do not render the mark
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: extends withServedCitation and QuoteNote; no new surface

functions.name: isCitationChecked
functions.output: true only for a proven clause or page
functions.if_none: returns false so the card shows the unchecked mark

functions.name: QuoteNote
functions.input: a provision row as served by the API
functions.output: quote note plus the unchecked mark
functions.if_none: the unchecked mark is shown (fail closed)

values.value: proven set: citation_status proven/imprecise; page_check on_page/moved

break_it.what_happens: flag would read as checked if NULL were coerced
break_it.how: non-string values coerce to empty and fail

break_it.scenario: an old API response has no citation_checked
break_it.what_happens: the card would hide the unchecked mark

break_it.scenario: a row has the read_by_person citation status
break_it.what_happens: it would be counted as machine-proven
break_it.how: not in the proven set, matching DQ-145

break_it.what_happens: the mark and the DQ-145 probe would disagree
break_it.how: parity test reads the SQL text

mutation_analysis: Forcing isCitationChecked to return true and the card condition to false failed 10 of 18 tests.
residual_risk: Surfaces fed by Planning Portal text or hand-written clause headings (LEP/SEPP cards, StateLevelControls links, checklists) pass checked=false because no script proves them. SEPP parking cards are API-only (no component mounts them). PDF export components are exempt in the inventory test and are a follow-up.
